newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended slightly higher after a day of low-volume activity punctuated by sporadic volatility.

Prices rose despite news U.S. manufacturing output rose 0.3 percent in August, after a 0.1 percent rise in July, and despite reports that eight of 12 Federal Reserve banks were said to favour an increase in the U.S. discount rate, now at 5.00 percent. The policy-setting FOMC meets on September 24.
Swiss bonds were encouraged by weak domestic GDP data but possibly undermined by a government bond issue next week. The Swiss Treasury plans an auction on September 26 SWIU.
